o.norm: test this isn't the last character in the string

i.norm: Verifies that no surrogate character appears without its required pair. In UTF-16, supplementary characters (code points above U+FFFF) are encoded as a high surrogate followed immediately by a low surrogate. A "lone surrogate" is a high or low surrogate that is missing its required partner adjacent to it. The generator must never produce lone surrogates.
